lead: Surprise plumbing deals with very hard water, desert heat and mostly newer slab homes. PipeMend sends licensed local plumbers across Surprise.
risk: very hard water scale, water heater wear and slab leaks
risk_short: hard water, water heaters and slab leaks
why: Most Surprise homes were built after 1995, including large retirement communities such as Sun City Grand. Original water heaters, softeners and fixtures in those homes are wearing out.
Homes sit on slabs, so leaks under the floor happen. Very hard water and summer heat shorten water heater life.
utility: City of Surprise Water and EPCOR
water: Surprise is served by the City of Surprise and, in some areas, by EPCOR. Supply is mostly groundwater plus Colorado River water. It is very hard.
tips: Flush your water heater every year.
Watch your water bill for slab leak signs.
Know which water provider serves your home.
areas: PipeMend works in the Original Town Site, Sun City Grand, Marley Park, Sierra Montana, Greer Ranch, Surprise Farms and every other Surprise neighborhood.
permits: Plumbing permits come from the City of Surprise Development Services, and contractors need an Arizona Registrar of Contractors license.

faq.a: Most homes get water from the City of Surprise, and some from EPCOR. Your water bill shows which one serves you. Both deliver very hard water.
